title: Safest Route
description:
The world map has `n` towns numbered `0` to `n - 1`. Each entry of `roads` is `[a, b, risk]`: a two-way road between towns `a` and `b` with a non-negative danger `risk`. Several roads may join the same towns.

Return the smallest total danger of a route from town `0` to town `n - 1`, or `-1` if no route exists. A route from a town to itself has danger `0`.
